verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֥י כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ שָׂפָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּדְבָרִ֖ים אֲחָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ śā·p̄āh ’e·ḥāṯ ū·ḏə·ḇā·rîm ’ă·ḥā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech
verses.literalPt: Ora, toda a terra tinha uma só linguagem e um só modo de falar.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י בְּנָסְעָ֣ם מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַֽיִּמְצְא֥וּ בִקְעָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·nā·sə·‘ām miq·qe·ḏem way·yim·ṣə·’ū ḇiq·‘āh bə·’e·reṣ šin·‘ār way·yê·šə·ḇū šām
verses.literal: And as people journeyed eastward they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there
verses.literalPt: Viajando os homens para o Oriente, acharam uma planície na terra de Sinear; e ali habitaram.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֗הוּ הָ֚בָה נִלְבְּנָ֣ה לְבֵנִ֔ים וְנִשְׂרְפָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֑ה וַתְּהִ֨י לָהֶ֤ם הַלְּבֵנָה֙ לְאָ֔בֶן וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ר הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לַחֹֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū hā·ḇāh nil·bə·nāh lə·ḇê·nîm wə·niś·rə·p̄āh liś·rê·p̄āh wat·tə·hî lā·hem hal·lə·ḇê·nāh lə·’ā·ḇen wə·ha·ḥê·mār hā·yāh lā·hem la·ḥō·mer
verses.literal: And they said to one another Come let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly So they used brick instead of stone and tar - instead of mortar
verses.literalPt: Disseram uns aos outros: Vinde, façamos tijolos e queimemo-los bem. Os tijolos lhes serviram de pedras, e o betume, de cal.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ הָ֣בָה׀ נִבְנֶה־ לָּ֣נוּ עִ֗יר וּמִגְדָּל֙ וְרֹאשׁ֣וֹ בַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנַֽעֲשֶׂה־ לָּ֖נוּ שֵׁ֑ם פֶּן־ נָפ֖וּץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hā·ḇāh niḇ·neh- lā·nū ‘îr ū·miḡ·dāl wə·rō·šōw ḇaš·šā·ma·yim wə·na·‘ă·śeh- lā·nū šêm pen- nā·p̄ūṣ ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Come they said let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth
verses.literalPt: E disseram: Vinde, edifiquemos para nós uma cidade e uma torre cujo cume chegue até o céu e façamo-nos um nome; para que não sejamos espalhados sobre a face de toda a terra.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣רֶד יְהוָ֔ה לִרְאֹ֥ת אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־ הַמִּגְדָּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ Yah·weh lir·’ōṯ ’eṯ- hā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- ham·miḡ·dāl ’ă·šer bā·nū bə·nê hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building
verses.literalPt: Porém, desceu Jeová para ver a cidade e a torre que os filhos dos homens edificavam.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה הֵ֣ן עַ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְשָׂפָ֤ה אַחַת֙ לְכֻלָּ֔ם וְזֶ֖ה הַחִלָּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וְעַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־ יִבָּצֵ֣ר מֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָזְמ֖וּ לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh hên ‘am ’e·ḥāḏ wə·śā·p̄āh ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḵul·lām wə·zeh ha·ḥil·lām la·‘ă·śō·wṯ wə·‘at·tāh lō- yib·bā·ṣêr mê·hem kōl ’ă·šer yā·zə·mū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: And the LORD said If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same . . . language then nothing . . . they devise . . . will be beyond them
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová: Eis que o povo é um só, e todos eles têm uma só linguagem. Isso é o que começam a fazer: agora, nada lhes será vedado de quanto intentam fazer.

verses.original: הָ֚בָה נֵֽרְדָ֔ה וְנָבְלָ֥ה שָׁ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפַ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇāh nê·rə·ḏāh wə·nā·ḇə·lāh šām śə·p̄ā·ṯām ’ă·šer lō yiš·mə·‘ū ’îš śə·p̄aṯ rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: Come let Us go down . . . and confuse their language so that they will not understand one another’s speech
verses.literalPt: Vinde, desçamos e confundamos ali a sua linguagem, para que não entendam a linguagem um do outro.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨פֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם מִשָּׁ֖ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחְדְּל֖וּ לִבְנֹ֥ת הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·p̄eṣ Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām miš·šām ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ way·yaḥ·də·lū liḇ·nōṯ hā·‘îr
verses.literal: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth and they stopped building the city
verses.literalPt: Assim Jeová os espalhou dali sobre a face de toda a terra; e cessaram de edificar a cidade.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּי־ שָׁ֛ם בָּלַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה שְׂפַ֣ת כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּמִשָּׁם֙ הֱפִיצָ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên qā·rā šə·māh bā·ḇel kî- šām bā·lal Yah·weh śə·p̄aṯ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·miš·šām hĕ·p̄î·ṣām Yah·weh ‘al- pə·nê kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: That is why . . . it is called Babel for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world and from that place the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth
verses.literalPt: Por isso, se chamou o seu nome Babel, porquanto ali confundiu Jeová a linguagem de toda a terra; e dali os espalhou sobre a face de toda a terra.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת שֵׁ֔ם שֵׁ֚ם בֶּן־ מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֑ד שְׁנָתַ֖יִם אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ šêm šēm ben- mə·’aṯ šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- ’ar·paḵ·šāḏ šə·nā·ṯa·yim ’a·ḥar ham·mab·būl
verses.literal: This is the account of Shem Two years after the flood when Shem was 100 years old he became the father of Arphaxad
verses.literalPt: Estas são as gerações de Sem. Tinha ele cem anos de idade, quando gerou a Arfaxade dois anos depois do dilúvio.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ שֵׁ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֔ד חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- šêm ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- ’ar·paḵ·šāḏ ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad Shem lived 500 . . . years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Sem, depois que gerou a Arfaxade, quinhentos anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֣ד חַ֔י חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ שָֽׁלַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·paḵ·šaḏ ḥay ḥā·mêš ū·šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- šā·laḥ
verses.literal: When Arphaxad was 35 . . . years old he became the father of Shelah
verses.literalPt: Arfaxade viveu trinta e cinco anos e gerou a Salá.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֗ד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ שֶׁ֔לַח שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî ’ar·paḵ·šaḏ ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- še·laḥ šā·lōš šā·nîm wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Shelah Arphaxad lived 403 . . . . . . years . . . and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Arfaxade, depois que gerou a Salá, quatrocentos e três anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֥לַח חַ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·laḥ ḥay šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- ‘ê·ḇer
verses.literal: When Shelah was 30 years old he became the father of Eber
verses.literalPt: Salá viveu trinta anos e gerou a Éber.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ שֶׁ֗לַח אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ עֵ֔בֶר שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- še·laḥ ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- ‘ê·ḇer šā·lōš šā·nîm wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Eber Shelah lived 403 . . . . . . . . . years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Salá, depois que gerou a Éber, quatrocentos e três anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ עֵ֕בֶר אַרְבַּ֥ע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ פָּֽלֶג׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- ‘ê·ḇer ’ar·ba‘ ū·šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- pā·leḡ
verses.literal: When Eber was 34 . . . years old he became the father of Peleg
verses.literalPt: Éber viveu trinta e quatro anos e gerou a Pelegue.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ עֵ֗בֶר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ פֶּ֔לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- ‘ê·ḇer ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- pe·leḡ šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Peleg Eber lived 430 . . . . . . . . . years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Éber, depois que gerou a Pelegue, quatrocentos e trinta anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ פֶ֖לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ רְעֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- p̄e·leḡ šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- rə·‘ū
verses.literal: When Peleg was 30 years old he became the father of Reu
verses.literalPt: Pelegue viveu trinta anos e gerou a Reú.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ פֶ֗לֶג אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ רְע֔וּ תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- p̄e·leḡ ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- rə·‘ū tê·ša‘ šā·nîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Reu Peleg lived 209 . . . . . . years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Pelegue, depois que gerou a Reú, duzentos e nove anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֔וּ שְׁתַּ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ שְׂרֽוּג׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî rə·‘ū šə·ta·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- śə·rūḡ
verses.literal: When Reu was 32 . . . years old he became the father of Serug
verses.literalPt: Reú viveu trinta e dois anos e gerou a Serugue.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ שְׂר֔וּג שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî rə·‘ū ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- śə·rūḡ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Serug Reu lived 207 . . . . . . years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Reú, depois que gerou a Serugue, duzentos e sete anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֥י שְׂר֖וּג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ נָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî śə·rūḡ šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- nā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: When Serug was 30 years old he became the father of Nahor
verses.literalPt: Serugue viveu trinta anos e gerou a Naor.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י שְׂר֗וּג אַחֲרֵ֛י הוֹלִיד֥וֹ אֶת־ נָח֖וֹר מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî śə·rūḡ ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- nā·ḥō·wr mā·ṯa·yim šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Nahor Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Serugue, depois que gerou a Naor, duzentos anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֔וֹר תֵּ֥שַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ תָּֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî nā·ḥō·wr tê·ša‘ wə·‘eś·rîm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- tā·raḥ
verses.literal: When Nahor was 29 . . . years old he became the father of Terah
verses.literalPt: Naor viveu vinte e nove anos e gerou a Tera.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֗וֹר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ תֶּ֔רַח תְּשַֽׁע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî nā·ḥō·wr ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·lî·ḏōw ’eṯ- te·raḥ tə·ša‘- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And after he had become the father of Terah Nahor lived 119 . . . . . . . . . years and had other sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Viveu Naor, depois que gerou a Tera, cento e dezenove anos; e gerou filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־ תֶ֖רַח שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֙וֹלֶד֙ אֶת־ אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־ נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־ הָרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî- ṯe·raḥ šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh way·yō·w·leḏ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rām ’eṯ- nā·ḥō·wr wə·’eṯ- hā·rān
verses.literal: When Terah was 70 years old he became the father of Abram Nahor and Haran
verses.literalPt: Tera viveu setenta anos e gerou a Abrão, a Naor e a Harã.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת תֶּ֔רַח תֶּ֚רַח הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־ נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־ הָרָ֑ן וְהָרָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ לֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ te·raḥ te·raḥ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rām ’eṯ- nā·ḥō·wr wə·’eṯ- hā·rān wə·hā·rān hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- lō·wṭ
verses.literal: This is the account of Terah Terah became the father of Abram Nahor and Haran And Haran became the father of Lot
verses.literalPt: Estas são as gerações de Tera: Tera gerou a Abrão, a Naor e a Harã; e Harã gerou a Ló.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָת הָרָ֔ן עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י תֶּ֣רַח אָבִ֑יו בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּ֖וֹ בְּא֥וּר כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ hā·rān ‘al- pə·nê te·raḥ ’ā·ḇîw bə·’e·reṣ mō·w·laḏ·tōw bə·’ūr kaś·dîm
verses.literal: During . . . his father Terah’s lifetime Haran died in his native land in Ur of the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: Harã morreu antes de seu pai Tera, na terra do seu nascimento, em Ur dos caldeus.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָ֧ם וְנָח֛וֹר לָהֶ֖ם נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־ אַבְרָם֙ שָׂרָ֔י וְשֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־ נָחוֹר֙ מִלְכָּ֔ה בַּת־ הָרָ֥ן אֲבִֽי־ מִלְכָּ֖ה וַֽאֲבִ֥י יִסְכָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’aḇ·rām wə·nā·ḥō·wr lā·hem nā·šîm šêm ’ê·šeṯ- ’aḇ·rām śā·rāy wə·šêm ’ê·šeṯ- nā·ḥō·wr mil·kāh baṯ- hā·rān ’ă·ḇî- mil·kāh wa·’ă·ḇî yis·kāh
verses.literal: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves Abram’s wife was named Sarai and Nahor’s wife was named Milcah she was the daughter of Haran who was the father of both Milcah . . . and Iscah
verses.literalPt: Abrão e Naor tomaram para si mulheres: o nome da mulher de Abrão era Sarai; e o nome da mulher de Naor era Milca, filha de Harã, que foi pai de Milca e pai de Iscá.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֥י שָׂרַ֖י עֲקָרָ֑ה אֵ֥ין לָ֖הּ וָלָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî śā·ray ‘ă·qā·rāh ’ên lāh wā·lāḏ
verses.literal: But Sarai was barren she had no children
verses.literalPt: Sarai era estéril; ela não tinha filhos.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח תֶּ֜רַח אֶת־ אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ ל֤וֹט בֶּן־ הָרָן֙ בֶּן־ בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ שָׂרַ֣י כַּלָּת֔וֹ אֵ֖שֶׁת אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּצְא֨וּ אִתָּ֜ם מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַד־ חָרָ֖ן וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ te·raḥ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rām bə·nōw wə·’eṯ- lō·wṭ ben- hā·rān ben- bə·nōw wə·’êṯ śā·ray kal·lā·ṯōw ’ê·šeṯ ’aḇ·rām bə·nōw way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’it·tām mê·’ūr kaś·dîm lā·le·ḵeṯ ’ar·ṣāh kə·na·‘an way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- ḥā·rān way·yê·šə·ḇū šām
verses.literal: And Terah took his son Abram his grandson . . . Lot son of Haran and his daughter-in-law Sarai the wife of Abram and they set out . . . from Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan But when they arrived in Haran they settled there
verses.literalPt: Tomou Tera a Abrão, seu filho, e a Ló, filho de Harã, filho de seu filho, e a Sarai, sua nora, mulher de seu filho Abrão, e saiu com eles de Ur dos caldeus para ir à terra de Canaã; vieram a Harã e ali habitaram.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־ תֶ֔רַח חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֥מָת תֶּ֖רַח בְּחָרָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū yə·mê- ṯe·raḥ ḥā·mêš šā·nîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim šā·nāh way·yā·māṯ te·raḥ bə·ḥā·rān
verses.literal: Terah lived . . . 205 . . . . . . years and he died . . . in Haran
verses.literalPt: Foram os dias de Tera duzentos e cinco anos; e morreu Tera em Harã.
